title: Make comfort and enjoy living in it

captions.physics: Carrying out a shared domestic idea
captions.energy: Adding care beyond what is enough

meaning: Making a home brings joy when its comfort can be used before care invents the next compulsory improvements.
text: You can make home more comfortable through steady action: choosing a direction, handling obstacles and carrying out an idea. The Chariot in the physical position of Muladhara describes moving towards a result. The Empress in energy tests your footing through excessive care that struggles to recognise enough. The Sun in emotions enjoys visible shared wellbeing: noticing the good place you have created together feels pleasant. Yet this bright response can quickly leave attention when every finished comfort immediately gains another condition, without which home still seems insufficiently lived in.

For example, you finish a small resting corner. You can already sit, put down a cup and read beside each other, but immediately want more plants and elaborate lighting. **A successful result deserves time to become your ordinary pleasure.** Joy continues through actual life, beyond brief assessment before another task. Shared effort makes home available, and care helps use what exists instead of continually proving you can arrange something better.

The difficulty is experiencing stopping as insufficient attention to home. Improvements continue while peaceful time together shrinks. Even something good becomes another step upwards. Support grows through being able to recognise a sufficiently arranged place without requiring joy first to pay for another portion of domestic work. What you have made can stay valuable without continually being enlarged.
